mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 68 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library. We have a full moon tonight, and the ISS passes overhead, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona reports that planning and zoning fees must be paid by check to the City Administration Building. Please be wary of emails that are not from a veronawi.gov address that ask for digital payments.
There is plenty to do, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today and trivia at Hop Haus tonight. Looking ahead, Verona Fall Fest happens tomorrow at Hometown USA Festival Park.
On September 5, a 26-year-old driver was arrested for operating with a prohibited alcohol concentration after being stopped for speeding on the highway.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a building remodel. We will let you know as soon as they are back to serving up their famous flavors.
